entities.summary: Peso Pluma (b. 1999-06-15, Zapopan) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Zapopan and Mexico. Known in the fields of mexico, composers & musicians, americas.
